description: This is a Java source file defining the LogFragment class, which extends Fragment. It creates a view containing a LogView inside a ScrollView, and updates the scroll position as new log data is appended. The class provides methods to inflate the view and access the LogView.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that displays a LogView inside a ScrollView, handling view inflation and text change events.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures a ScrollView containing a LogView with specified padding and styles, returns the ScrollView.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Overrides Fragment method to inflate the views, add a TextWatcher to scroll to the bottom on text change, and return the view hierarchy.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used inside this fragment.
